line: A 5-second brand opener: the first half of the title types on the beat, the cursor morphs into a selection band, the wheel rolls past the theme word, rests on a contrast word, spins back and locks the theme word in brand yellow on the music drop. The theme word can be a number (10倍) or any word (暂停).
line_cn: 5 秒厂牌片头：前半句踏拍打出，光标变成选中带，滚轮滚过主题词、停在反差词上一拍，再旋回主题词在音乐落点锁定变黄；主题词可以是数字（10倍）也可以是词（暂停）。
source: Own work: newbeer.lee brand opener v3 (2026-11-10), from the v7 film opener of《如果你的反应快10倍》; direction approved by the owner.
license: Fonts, all SIL OFL 1.1: Fusion Pixel 12px (github.com/TakWolf/fusion-pixel-font), ZCOOL KuaiLe 站酷快乐体 (github.com/googlefonts/zcool-kuaile), Smiley Sans Oblique 得意黑 (github.com/atelier-anchor/smiley-sans), Noto Serif SC Black 思源宋体 and Noto Sans SC Black 思源黑体 (github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk), Noto Sans Mono CJK SC (signature). SFX: synthesised in code (sfx.py), no third-party audio.
audio: public test.mp4 has no BGM: synthesised SFX only (the public site strips the audio track as well). The internal-review song 'We Never' has no licence proof and is not in this library.
test_content: test.mp4 = number example (如果你的反应快 2倍…10倍 → 反差 1倍 → 锁定 10倍, pixel skin) + word example (如果你能 加速…暂停 → 反差 加速 → 锁定 暂停 + 时间, data skin), both 16:9, no BGM, 10.2 s
params: --prefix --values (last item = theme word, number or word) --contrast --suffix --sub --drop --skin --aspect; --from/--to/--unit is only a shortcut for number lists
motion_gate: self-score 65.8 (<90), not a gate-passed film system
